messages.subject: Hello from ODM!
parts:
Hello!

WebODM founder here, just wanted to say that I love the project (also happy to see WebODM is being used and mentioned :).

I was wondering if you'd be interesting in having a chat about possibly joining OpenDroneMap as a project? We just launched an initiative to bring open-source drone software together and FIELDImageR might be a very good fit, I think, especially considering that it already uses some of the ODM software.

Details: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd7Wm9sWifDHoFOR31HHTwiOYqp0SUa_Lg57Ajyuy_tqw3odw/viewform

Cheers,

messages.subject: Re: Hello from ODM!
parts:
Hi Piero,

Thanks for contacting me. I really appreciate your work and ODM group... Congrats.
Deftly, I would love to talk about my project and see how to make it more accessible. Do you have a suggestion about the meeting date?

Best,
Filipe Matias
